<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **6** package(s): `@objectstack/connector-app-docusign`, `@objectstack/connector-app-github`, `@objectstack/connector-app-stripe`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/dogfood`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **8** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/apps/connector-docusign/objectstack.config.ts`, `packages/apps/connector-github/objectstack.config.ts`, `packages/apps/connector-stripe/objectstack.config.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via PROTOCOL_VERSION (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v13.mdx`  _(via PROTOCOL_VERSION (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v14.mdx`  _(via PROTOCOL_VERSION (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`  _(via PROTOCOL_VERSION (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx`  _(via PROTOCOL_VERSION (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **6** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/apps/connector-docusign/objectstack.config.ts`, `packages/apps/connector-github/objectstack.config.ts`, `packages/apps/connector-stripe/objectstack.config.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **182** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `09d601ca4abbce1f7842cd397b464b480084917e` — the merge of head `43133e8ce5093a29ef8587213c3d2266651731fc` into base `c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 09d601ca4abbce1f7842cd397b464b480084917e && git checkout 09d601ca4abbce1f7842cd397b464b480084917e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440 43133e8ce5093a29ef8587213c3d2266651731fc && git checkout -B drift-repro c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440 && git merge --no-ff 43133e8ce5093a29ef8587213c3d2266651731fc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c2f8bff93f6484c43b7667955a0a3541c1454440` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `e05fdf6f1895c288104746e9d54416eb3cdb6b45` · 2026-11-25T17:48Z

PR #37314, PR 1 of 2 for #37229: `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 18 → 19, 84 handshakes to `'^19'`, the step-19 ADR-0087 entry. Read against GitHub and the tree at this head, not against the report. The direction is right and the dev's three questions are answered as built. CI is red at this head on a test the constant move breaks. Two must-fix and two should-fix are open.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Open, draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37229`, no closing keyword on another card. Title carries `!`. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, opened by relay.
- **Diff, read whole.** 74 files, +206 / −95 against merge base `dfdebfadd5` (8 commits). 84 `engines.protocol` sites in 66 files move `'^18'` → `'^19'`, counted from the diff; the body's per-directory table matches. The other hunks are the constant and its docblock, `step19` in `registry.ts.template`, the new semantic entry, two module-top imports in edited fixtures, the option-B fixture, the `cli.json` checklist fact, the two changesets and the i18n script.
- **Premise.** #37230 merged (2026-11-25T12:51Z, `5cf9941d3f`); `.changeset/pre.json` reads `mode: pre`, tag `next`. `main` added no `'^18'` handshake between the merge base and `dbc1765a24`.
- **Card's Done-when.** `protocol-version.test.ts` 3/3 at this head; the guard output is quoted in the body and reproduced below.
- **Tier.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37314`: not governed, 301 changed lines. `record-recognisers.mjs --template` on the 74 paths: the schema face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The declared narrowing sends it to the maintainer.
- **Declarations.** Body and changeset both read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. `Skills-docs:` is present; the three skill files move in #37298.

### Gates

- **Check-runs at this head (all complete, read 2026-11-25T17:46Z).** 78 runs: 59 success, 13 expected skip, 0 pending, 6 not green. `Test Core (2/10)` and its roll-up `Test Core` are `failure`: M1. `Check Changeset` is `failure` twice (two runs of this head) and red by design, next bullet. One `Check Changeset` and one `PR-body guards` run are `cancelled`, superseded by later runs of the same head; the later `PR-body guards` run is green. Lint, type check, Test UI 16/16 and the other nine Test Core shards are green.
- **`Check Changeset` is red by design.** It refuses the edit to `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md`, a changeset on the merge base (DELIBERATE CORRECTION). Its later steps ran and are green in the same job: `check-adr-0087-registration` (`registered protocol-18-range-refused (new here)`), `This diff introduces no major bump`, the LEVEL AXIS line for `yes (narrowing)` + `narrowed`, and the protocol lockstep line. The correction is confirmed in the record (`record-37314.md`, ②), sentence quoted before and after. A PR comment naming the gate and the reason is still owed before any landing.
- **Run here, read-only, in a throwaway worktree at this head (since removed).**
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. `✓ Protocol lockstep: PROTOCOL_VERSION major 19, @objectstack/spec@18.6.0 — the one exception, evidenced: pre mode (tag next) and a pending major for @objectstack/spec (.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md).`
  - `check:adr-0087-registration`: self-test exit 0 (819 assertions), then exit 0, `registered protocol-18-range-refused (new here: protocol-18-range-refused)`.
  - Option-B test, built dist reads `PROTOCOL_VERSION = "19.0.0"`: `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 6 passed (6)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Positive control, the five sites put back to `'^18'`: `1 failed`, `3 passed | 3 skipped`, the three boot suites refused with `targets protocol ^18 (engines.protocol) but this runtime is protocol 19.0.0`.
  - Kept sites: metadata-core 3 files 513/513, metadata 3 files 19/19, `template-consistency.test.ts` 41/41, `protocol-version-gap.test.ts` 16/16.
- **`git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `dbc1765a24`:** clean. The two PRs share no path.
- **K.** `landing-k.mjs --pr 37314`: CAN'T ANSWER, exit 3: no completed run on this PR's commits has a green `Test Core`. Not a 0. The red run printed its affected-set base as `fbb62e1cca`, one first-parent commit behind `origin/main` `dbc1765a24`. Read K again on the reworked head.

### The dev's open questions, as seat L1 judgments

- **Q1 — `yes (narrowing)` + `narrowed` with a step-19 entry, not `semantic`: right.** AGENTS.md grades "a value refused" as `narrowed`, and `narrowed` outranks `semantic`. A 19 runtime refuses `'^18'`, which 18 admitted, and admits `'^19'`, which 18 refused: one surface narrows and one widens, which is what `yes (narrowing)` says. #22215 declared the same arm. The claim's `no` + `semantic` was a prediction made before the measurement. Given `narrowed`, the gate refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, so a registered entry is the only disposition; `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` is right because the `major` is #37230's.
- **Q2 — the blank template stays `'^18'` until the version pass: right.** `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` stamps `engines: { protocol: '^${major}' }` from the scaffolder's own version, and `template-consistency.test.ts` holds the template to `create-objectstack`'s major (18.6.0). Moving it by hand reds that test and is overwritten at the cut anyway. Same call as #22215.
- **Q3 — the metadata and metadata-core sites are kept, and the option-B file moves to `'>=18.0.0'`: right.** The kept files inject the runtime label or run no handshake; their `'^18'` is the floor under test, and they pass unchanged at protocol 19. The option-B file boots through the load seam, which does run the handshake. `'>=18.0.0'` keeps the 18.0.0 floor `parseRangeFloor` read from `'^18'` and admits 19, as #22215's `>=17.1.0` did. Two of the five sites (the `loadArtifactBundle` case and the database resolver) never reach the handshake and move for consistency only.

### Judgments table against the tree

`git grep` at this head: 180 lines hold `^18` outside `CHANGELOG.md`, `content/docs/releases/**`, `docs/adr/**` and the lockfile. Each was read. The table covers all but the sites in S2. Not in the table by name, and correctly left: retired `specVersion: '^18.0.0'` fixtures, `tedious@^18.0.0`, React peer ranges, `10^18`, `scripts/sync-template-versions.mjs` comments, and the docblocks in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts` and `packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`; none is a handshake against the current protocol.

### Changesets and docs, sentence by sentence

- `.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md`: every sentence holds except the `--write` claim for multi-package manifests (S1).
- `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md`: the one rewritten sentence is true (record ②). See N3 for a neighbour.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`, `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`, `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`: one literal each, `'^19'`. True for the tree; see N4 for npm `latest`.

### Findings

- M1 (must-fix) — `Test Core (2/10)` is red at this head, and this PR causes it. `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` fails three cases: `object-grid-single-click-edit-removed`, `field-inline-edit-boolean-removed`, `view-column-state-removed`. First error: "object-grid.singleClickEdit (parse): retiredAfter 18.6.0 (newest published stable 18.6.0) derives @objectstack/spec 19, but the prescription names 18 — … was removed in @objectstack/spec 18.7.0". Reproduced here at the head itself, without `main` merged in: `Tests 3 failed | 62 passed (65)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 1`. The same shard is green on `main` `fbb62e1cca`. The pin derives the removing release's major from `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`; at 19 the retirements stamped `retiredAfter 18.6.0` must name the 19 line, and their prescriptions still say 18.7.0, a release the v19 line never cuts. The three entries were on the merge base, so the dev's run would have shown it; the body's test list names "the spec kernel/migrations/conversions suites", not the whole spec suite. The text lives in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:5469`, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1674` and `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3497` and `:6392`. `git grep "18\.7\.0"` at this head finds 14 lines in 10 files outside `CHANGELOG.md`: also `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:50` and `:54`, the generated `content/docs/references/ui/{component,view}.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:147` and `:175`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json:3260`, and the pending `.changeset/37042-skills-inline-edit-boolean.md` (another DELIBERATE CORRECTION if it is touched). The dev measures which of these the move makes false and moves them with the constant; the fix cannot land ahead of it, because the pin holds them at 18 while `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` is 18.
- M2 (must-fix) — `packages/mcp/README.md` changes (two snippets) and `@objectstack/mcp` ships `README.md` (`files: ["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`, `private: false`), but no changeset names the package. `.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md` names `@objectstack/spec` alone. #22215 touched the same README and declared `'@objectstack/mcp': patch`. A published package without its changeset does not enter the queue. The other packages the diff touches change test files only, which do not ship, and `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/` is outside that package's `files[]`. Fix: a `patch` entry for `@objectstack/mcp`; re-run `check-changeset-no-major` on the result.
- S1 (should-fix) — the step-19 entry and the changeset promise more than `--write` does. `19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts` says `--write` "rewrites the declared range at the key the handshake reads" and, under `acceptanceCriteria`, "Grep every manifest the project declares (objectstack.config.ts and each package manifest) … which rewrites each to '^19'"; the changeset says the same of "every package manifest in a multi-package app". Measured at this head on `examples/app-multi-package` with both package manifests put back to `'^18'`: `os migrate meta --from 18 --write` wrote nothing and printed "The declared protocol range was left for you to change by hand … not written [helper]: manifest is composed by composeStacks(…) from all of its inputs, so no one literal is its source". On a single-manifest app (`examples/app-todo`) it does rewrite `objectstack.config.ts:48 … '^18' → '^19'`. Fix the three strings: `--write` rewrites a range that is one literal in the config, and reports a composed manifest for a hand edit in each package manifest. The entry text ships in `spec-changes.json`, the upgrade guide and the CLI's own advisory.
- S2 (should-fix) — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay` (active, P1): its title, a fixture, a step and the acceptance clause "^17 → 422 OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE with migrateCommand naming --from 17; ^18 admitted" are false once the runtime is protocol 19, and its step "boot a ^18 dist/objectstack.json built before a retirement" is now refused at the handshake. The Judgments table has no row for it, while the PR did correct the same kind of fact in `cli.json`. Either revise the item here, or give it a row and a filed follow-up card; the seat chooses.
- N1 — body: "74 files, +210 / −95". GitHub and `git diff --stat` both read +206 / −95.
- N2 — `protocol-version.ts` docblock: "every in-repo manifest that means the current protocol declares '^19' with it". The blank template and three skill files do not until the version pass and #37298. It is published TSDoc; soften it in the rework push.
- N3 — `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md` still says "`PROTOCOL_VERSION` follows `@objectstack/spec`'s major at version time". After this PR the constant is already 19 and the sync is a no-op. Loosely true; the note is being corrected anyway.
- N4 — the three docs pages show `'^19'` while npm `latest` is 18.6.0, whose runtime refuses `'^19'`. Same as #22215; the changeset says to move the range with the versions. Accepted, and named in the maintainer summary.
- N5 — the option-B fixture carries no comment saying why its range is `'>=18.0.0'`. A later sweep to `'^19'` would close the window and red the file, so it is self-protecting.
- N6 — `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-protocol-range.test.ts:46` still says "since the runtime implements protocol 18". Comment only.
- N7 — `Skills-docs: none in this PR — …` would read more exactly as `follow-up #37298`.

### Dogfood

Owed, and not yet on record. The title's `!` and the `(narrowing)` arm both mark this PR. The newest trusted `os-dev-report` on #37229 is 7160769126: `pr: null`, `dogfood_battery: "n/a — no PR"`. `landDogfoodGate` in `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` fails closed on that. The dev's full battery (487 files passed, 3 skipped; 4128 tests passed, 68 skipped) ran on `9da4c1d4` plus an unpushed copy of the fixture fix, not on this head, and is recorded only in the PR body. `e05fdf6f18` is a one-parent commit on `9da4c1d4`, so the gate's first-parent walk over merges of the base cannot reach `9da4c1d4` either. The delta is one runtime test file outside `packages/qa/dogfood`, so the old run is good evidence; it is not the record the gate reads. Because M1, M2 and S1 move the head, run the full battery once on the final head and post #37229 an `os-dev-report` whose `pr` names #37314 and whose `dogfood_battery` opens with that head's sha.

### Seat-side items (no dev work)

- **Claim line.** The newest `Claim:` comment on #37229 is 7160363498. Through `readClause2Line` it reads `Clause-②: no`; through `readMetadataProtocolLine` it reads `semantic`. The PR body reads `yes (narrowing)` and `narrowed`. Both lines differ. The amendment 7161510004 is not a `Claim:` comment and carries neither line. The seat amends the claim.
- **Closing keyword.** `Fixes #37229` closes the card when this PR merges, while #37298 (`Refs`) is still open for the card's other half. Either this PR becomes `Part of` and #37298 closes the card, or the body says the card closes here on purpose.
- **Follow-up card owed, out of this PR.** #37287 has merged with a retirement registered under step 18, and 30 step-18 semantic entry files have been added on `main` since the `@objectstack/spec@18.6.0` tag. They first ship in 19.0.0, and once step 19 exists `os migrate meta --from 18` replays step 19 only. The body notes this for #37287 as "not filed"; it now needs a card.
- **Body corrections:** N1, the S2 row, and N7.

### Verdict

REWORK, round 1: M1, M2, S1, and S2 if the seat chooses the in-PR fix. M1 widens the file surface to four `*.zod.ts` prescription strings and their generated docs, so the claim's file surface is amended in the same stroke. Then the full spec suite and the full dogfood battery on the final head. The contract-review record on this head is FAIL (`record-37314.md`, M1 and S1). No hand-off is written.

### Landing

- Not handed to the maintainer in this round. When it is, the order stands: #37298 (PR 2) only after this PR (PR 1) is on `main`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e05fdf6f1895c288104746e9d54416eb3cdb6b45`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ordered local reads in a throwaway worktree at this head: the two changeset guards, the option-B test with a `'^18'` control, the kept-site test files, the failing `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`, and `os migrate meta --from 18 --write` on `examples/app-todo` and `examples/app-multi-package` put back to `'^18'`; nothing was pushed and the worktree is removed
Scope: packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template + packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion.test.ts, packages/metadata/src/plugin-artifact-packages-attribution.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation-contributed-nav-bundle.test.ts, the five example manifests under examples/, the three connector manifests under packages/apps/, the 40 packages/cli test files, the nine packages/qa files, the two packages/lint test files, docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json, packages/mcp/README.md and ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs (the whole diff outside the prose faces, since a narrowing is declared)

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face.** Read off the committed tree: three paths under `packages/spec/src/**`, the schema face. The declared `(narrowing)` arm widens the scope to every path outside the prose faces.
- **`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` holds.** At this head the handshake refuses a range that admits 18 and not 19, which 18 admitted (measured: `targets protocol ^18 (engines.protocol) but this runtime is protocol 19.0.0`), and admits `'^19'`, which 18 refused. One accept set narrows and one widens; the exported `PROTOCOL_VERSION` value moves. #22215 (`4e9fe9f`) declared the same arm for 17 → 18.
- **`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` holds.** AGENTS.md grades "a value refused" as `narrowed`, and `narrowed` outranks `semantic`. The claim's `semantic` (comment 7160363498) was written before the dev measured the refusal.
- **ADR-0087 disposition.** `registered protocol-18-range-refused`. `check-adr-0087-registration` at this head: `[BREAKING+clause-②-narrowing+metadata-protocol-narrowed] registered protocol-18-range-refused (new here)`, exit 0, in CI and here. The gate refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on a declared `narrowed`, so an entry is the only route.
- **PR body and changeset agree** on both lines, read through `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine`.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec`: `minor` is right. A kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves. `major` is refused in this lane and is already carried by `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md` (#37230). CI's LEVEL AXIS line is green for this pair.
- Protocol lockstep: `PROTOCOL_VERSION major 19, @objectstack/spec@18.6.0 — the one exception, evidenced: pre mode (tag next) and a pending major for @objectstack/spec`. Exit 0 here and in CI.
- `@objectstack/mcp` has no entry although its shipped `README.md` changes. That is the seat's L1 item M1; the changeset is a prose face and outside this record.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION, confirmed.** One note, `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md`, one sentence.
  - Before: "The first is `@object-ui/i18n`'s retirement of the translation keys 18.6.0 shipped and no code reads any more; a second `major` in the same `fixed` group still gives one 19.0.0."
  - After: "The first change graded `major` is `@object-ui/i18n`'s retirement of the translation keys 18.6.0 shipped and no code reads any more; a second `major` in the same `fixed` group still gives one 19.0.0."
  - Judgment: the old sentence followed "Each breaking change on the line says so in its own changeset", so "the first" meant the first breaking change. This PR adds a breaking change graded `minor`, which makes that reading false. The new wording is true: `.changeset/37223-i18n-removed-released-keys.md` is the retirement and is graded `major`; this PR's changeset is `minor`. No other sentence of the note is changed. `Check Changeset` stays red on it by design.
